Question 17
?

The base of a solid is the region enclosed by the curves y=1−x2 and y=−1, as shown in the picture. Cross-sections perpendicular to the x-axis are rectangles. If the height of each rectangle is 2 times the length of its base, which integral gives the volume of the solid?

a
2∫−22(4−x4)dx
b
2∫−22(2−x2)dx
c
∫−22(4−4x2+x4)dx
d
∫−22(8−8x2+2x4)dx
e
∫−22(8−4x+2x2)dx
Don't Know
Submit
